unlocks.steampunk_boss_unlock: Unlocks access to the Sovereign Airship Docks and reveals the blueprint to stabilize the regional ether grid.
unlocks.post_apocalyptic_boss_unlock: Restores clean water flow across the wasteland and unlocks the sealed pre-collapse underground bunker.
unlocks.sunless_ocean_boss_unlock: Calms the raging abyssal tides and unveils the submerged coordinates to the Sunken Isle of Kings.
unlocks.floating_isles_boss_unlock: Stabilizes the float-altitude of the archipelagos and opens the ancient portal to the Celestial Heavens.
unlocks.sun_desert_boss_unlock: Ends the eternal drought by summoning primeval rainfall and unlocks the lost Library of the Sun.
unlocks.solarpunk_boss_unlock: Cleanses the fungal blight affecting the canopy and unlocks the legendary Sun-Canopy Flying Gardens.
unlocks.pactlands_boss_unlock: Binds the dark fiendish rifts across the realm and grants the party passage into the Nether Realm.
unlocks.vampire_courts_boss_unlock: Abolishes the aristocratic blood tax and grants control over Castle Sanguine and its hidden vaults.
unlocks.silk_route_boss_unlock: Unlocks the exclusive Silk Route Merchant Charter, granting unlimited trade concessions across all empires.
